_comment: Cheap gates for Stage A (harvest.py) ONLY. The real judging — seatbelts, bed layout, damp risk, budget, age, value vs market — lives in research-prompt.md, because it needs the detail page and the web, not a regex. 2026-07-26: dropped max_age_years (Stage A has no basis to hard-reject on age — the brief says never discard on mileage/age alone) and the wallapop geo-filter (Wallapop itself was removed, see harvest.py's SOURCES). min_price/max_price stay as documented values Stage B reads, but are no longer enforced as a Stage A reject either, for the same reason.
